hypotheses.title: Subindustry Operating Cash Flow Solvency and Short-Term Price Reversion Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Companies generating superior Funds from Operations (fnd6_fopo) relative to their long-term debt obligations (debt_lt) possess high structural solvency, credit durability, and earnings quality. Applying a quadratic power transform sharpens capital allocation toward top debt-serviceable balance sheets within each subindustry, while a 15% 3-day price reversal overlay provides agile microstructure mean reversion, optimizing risk-adjusted performance and sub-universe stability.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if high debt coverage firms suffer from structural capital under-utilization that causes chronic relative equity underperformance.

candidates.rationale: Option A (8/8 PASS): Quadratic power-scaled FFO to long-term debt solvency ratio with 15% 3-day short-term delta reversal stabilizer
